Commentary.Commentary: 227 is the target now. Is it defendable? Yes, but Bangladesh will need to bowl extremely well. The Kiwis on the other hand, will probably feel they have a golden opportunity to seal the series here itself. Join us for the second half to find out what will happen. A shorter than normal mid-innings break today...

The Kiwi bowlers weren't at their best today. Yes, every bowler did take a wicket but except for Matt Henry and to some extent Lockie Ferguson, none of the bowlers were up to the mark. Todd Astle controlled things in the middle but was expensive in the context of the game. There were too many extras and too many poor deliveries and worsened by poor fielding as well. In fact, extras were almost equal to the number of runs of the third highest score of any Bangladeshi individual in this innings. The hosts have still restricted Bangladesh to a total they will be pleased with but Williamson won't be happy with how they went along with things, knowing it could have been much lesser.

After being inserted, the away side once again got off to the worst of starts as they lost their top order even before crossing 50. Their middle order also failed to make an impact and they were reeling at 93 for 5. However, Mithun along with Sabbir added a 75-run stand which gave some respectability to the score. The former went onto score consecutive fifties. Bangladesh would have dearly loved for one of the two to stay till the end but that was not to be. Once the two got dismissed, the lower order failed to add anything substantial.

Another poor batting display by Bangladesh comes to an end. Now why I write poor is because New Zealand were way below their normal standards with the ball and in the field. Plenty of extras, too many dropped catches and quite a few run out chances missed. Despite that, the visitors have not put up a total which one can say could be competitive on this wicket.

OUT! Bangladesh have been bowled out! Neesham gets the last man. Mortaza moves across and looks to paddle but the ball is a little too full. He ends up hitting it uppishly towards short fine leg. Trent Boult there takes a good diving catch. BANGLADESH END WITH 226!
A good yorker outside off, Mortaza fails to jam it out. Not a lot you can do with that delivery.
Length delivery on off, Mustafizur plays it towards point. The fielder throws it at the bowler's end but misses the stumps. The batsmen take a run.
Full and outside off, Mortaza makes room and looks to drive but gets an outside edge. It goes towards third man for a run.
James Neesham to bowl the final over.
Outside off, almost a yorker length ball. Rahman manages to keep it out towards mid off. A good end to the over from Henry off which came 7 runs. He ends with amazing figures of 10-2-30-1.
Brilliant yorker, well kept out by Mustafizur in the end.

Mashrafe hits this fuller length ball really hard towards mid off. The fielder cannot stop it properly and allows for a single to be taken. Mustafizur was late on the run but makes it safely in the end.
Good comeback from Henry! A brilliant yorker following the batsman who was making room. Mortaza misses the ball.

SIX! Where has that one come from? Henry will not like that one bit. A leg spinner type ball from Matt out of the back of the hands outside off. Mortaza lines it up, goes on one knee and picks the bones out of it as he deposits it over deep extra-cover. BIG!
Slower ball bouncer on middle, Mashrafe backs away and looks to hit it over point. The ball misses the bat though.
Henry is back on.
The batsman has done well to keep that yorker at bay. Ferguson ends his bowling today with a brilliant final over. 1 run off it. He has figures of 10-0-43-3.
Lockie goes fuller this time and Rahman goes for the drive on the off side after backing away. The ball goes off the inside edge and onto the pads. No run though as the ball goes back to the bowler.
Almost an action replay of the previous ball. Another try from the Fizz to ramp it over the keeper's head but he manages to get only contact with thin air.
A short of a length ball and coming into the lefty, Rahman makes room to poke at the ball but fails to make any connection.
Around the wicket, the length ball outside off is missed by Mustafizur as he swings through the line.
Bouncer on middle, Mortaza awkwardly plays it towards the third man region. The ball goes uppishly but well short of the fielder.

FOUR! He gets more than just willow on that one! A length ball outside off and this time, Mustafizur uses the long handle and lifts the ball over the head of mid off for a boundary. Useful runs. Boult ends the day with figures of 10-1-49-1.
Length ball outside off once more and once again, 'The Fizz' fails to put bat on ball as he tries to push it towards the off side.
Length ball outside off and Mustafizur swings through the line, but fails to make any contact.
Fuller one outside off, the ball takes the outside edge of the batsman and runs towards the third man fielder for a run.
Full toss outside off and Mortaza can only play it towards the point region.
A short of a length ball and Mashrafe plays a mistimed pull towards mid on.
Full on off, Rahman plays it to covers.
Mustafizur Rahman is the last man to bat.

OUT! BOWLED 'EM! Bangladesh lose their ninth wicket. Full delivery on off, Saifuddin looks to flick but gets an inside edge and the ball rolls onto the stumps. This is good bowling from Lockie Ferguson. He gets his third wicket.
Short of a length delivery, Mortaza comes down the track and it goes over third man. The batsmen cross ends.
Good length delivery on off, Mortaza keeps it out.
Length delivery on middle, Saifuddin flicks it towards mid-wicket for a run.
Good length delivery outside off, Mortaza guides it towards third man for a run.
Length delivery on middle, Saifuddin flicks it to mid-wicket.
Full on off, Mortaza drives it towards covers for a run.
Bowls it wide outside off, Mortaza looks to chase this but misses it.
BEATEN! Good length delivery outside off, Mortaza looks to defend but gets beaten by the away movement on this one.
Short delivery, Saifuddin pulls it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Full on off, Saifuddin plays it straight towards the bowler.
Trent Boult is back on.
A good fuller length ball on the middle stump line that is kept out by the Bangladeshi skipper to end the over. 2 runs and a wicket off the over.
Mashrafe Mortaza is next to the crease.

OUT! Slowing down the pace does the trick! This is a huge wicket in the context, could make a difference of 15-20 runs to the final total. Ferguson who has been bowling over 145 kph so far has brought this one down by around 20 clicks and bowls this outside off. Sabbir is early into the drive, and through his shot by the time the ball arrived. It thus takes the outside half and flies towards point. The ball dips on the fielder but Neesham out there comes ahead and completes a good, low catch. Bangladesh in danger of not playing out their quota of 50 overs now.
A quick single from the Bangladeshi batsmen. Length ball on the hips, tucked towards the on side by Saifuddin and he sets off. Had to dive in the end to get home safely.
A slower ball bouncer on top of off, Sabbir rocks back and then plays the upper cut towards third man. It is well controlled and goes for a single.
A fuller length ball, 147.4 clicks this time. Rahman gets under it but does not get the elevation required as he hits it to mid on on the bounce.
Good pacy yorker outside off. 147.3 kph! Sabbir gets his bat down in time and jams it towards mid off.
Length delivery on middle, Rahman flicks it towards square leg for a single. Good comeback from Neesham despite going for a boundary. 6 runs came from it.
Full on off, Sabbir plays it to covers.
Short and outside off, Rahman cuts it to point.
Short delivery again, Rahman pulls it to mid-wicket.
FOUR! 200 up for Bangladesh. HAMMERED AWAY! Short of a length delivery, Rahman comes down the track and smashes it straight past the bowler for a boundary.
Short delivery outside off, Saifuddin cuts it towards point for a single.
A loose shot but Sabbir fails to time it well. The ball on a length is hit towards mid on on a couple of bounces. 6 off this over.
Wide! An attempted bouncer on middle goes too high. The umpire penalises it as the ball was well over the batsman's head.
Fuller ball on middle, worked away stylishly on the leg side for a single by the southpaw.
Hurled in short of a length and outside off, Saifuddin just drops his wrists and lets that one go.
Another full one on the pads, flicked away towards mid-wicket but no run this time as the ball goes straight to the fielder.
A length ball on the hips, tucked away towards deep square leg for a couple of runs. The second was possible because of the poor timing on that shot.
Fuller length ball on the pads, flicked away through mid-wicket for a brace by Saifuddin.
Lockie Ferguson is back into the attack.
Length delivery on off, the batsman plays it towards third man for a run. Good over from James Neesham. 2 runs and a wicket from the over.
On off, Saifuddin keeps it out.
Good length delivery outside off, Saifuddin shoulders his arms to this one.
Short of a length delivery, Rahman pulls it through mid-wicket for a run.
Mohammad Saifuddin is the new man in.

OUT! Neesham strikes! Mehidy Hasan goes. Short of a length delivery, Hasan comes down the track and looks to go over covers but gets a top edge. It goes to Henry Nicholls at point who takes a simple catch. The visitors lose their seventh wicket.
Bowls a bouncer, Mehidy does well to duck under it.
Powerplay 3 has been signaled! Now 5 fielders can be placed outside the ring till the end of the innings. Also, James Neesham is back on.
FOUR! Finishes the over with a bang. A length ball on middle and Rahman dances down the track and pulls this away wide of mid on for a boundary. 7 runs off the over.
Short of a length, dabbed down to backward point for a single.
On a length and played with soft hands towards the point fielder.

DROPPED! Another one goes down, the fourth of this innings. Henry Nicholls the culprit this time. The other Henry will not be pleased. A length ball outside off, Mehidy premeditates and dances down the track to smash it over the covers. Nicholls at deep covers initially misjudges it and comes in. Realising he has to go back a few steps, he does so and tries to take the catch above his head. The ball though does not stick in his hand. Another chance goes begging for the Kiwis. They have been poor in the field today.
On a shorter length, Hasan looks to tuck it on the leg side but it goes straight to square leg fielder.
Fuller one on the off stump, driven back towards mid on by Mehidy but for no run.
Short delivery, Rahman cuts it to point. Todd Astle finishes with figures of 10-0-52-2.
Full on off, Rahman drives it to mid off.
Flighted delivery on off, Mehidy drives it towards covers for a run.
Full again on off, Rahman drives it through mid off. The batsmen cross ends.
Full on off, Hasan drives it towards mid off for a run.
Tossed up on off, Mehidy defends off the front foot.
On off, Sabbir defends off the back foot. Good over from Henry, just 1 run off it in the end.
Good length delivery on middle, Rahman blocks it off the back foot.
Good length delivery outside off, Hasan looks to drive but gets an outside edge towards third man. The batsmen take a single.
Length delivery on middle, Hasan pushes it to mid-wicket.
Bowls a bouncer, Mehidy does well to duck under it.
Good length delivery on middle and leg, Hasan looks to flick but gets hit on the thigh pad.
Flighted delivery on off, Rahman plays it to point.
Tossed up on middle, Rahman defends off the back foot.
Floated on off, Sabbir blocks it off the front foot.
Flighted deliverly on off, Hasan drives it towards covers for a run.
Short on off, Rahman makes room and cuts it towards point for a run.
Tossed up on leg, Mehidy plays it towards mid on for a single.
Fuller and on middle, Rahman strokes it towards mid on.
Good length on off, kept out.
Back of a length and on off, Rahman pushes it to mid on.

NOT OUT! Height is a factor as the ball is going over! Sabbir survives! Excellent use of the review there. It is a delivery which is bowled just behind a length around off, it comes back in. Sabbir goes back to defend but misses to get hit on the back pad. An appeal follows and the umpire raises his finger. Sabbir has to go for the review and he does so. Replays roll in and it shows the ball to be going over.
Review time... Sabbir has been given out LBW here. Looked like he was in front of the stumps but there is a chance that the height might be a factor here. Let's see what the replays have to say.
Good length delivery outside off, Rahman shoulders his arms to this one.
Full toss on middle and leg, Mehidy flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Matt Henry is back into the attack.

A slider on the pads, worked fine by Mehidy towards the fine leg region. A long chase from Taylor as he just prevents the ball from going to the fence and saves a run for his team. Good end for Bangladesh to this over but it was a successful one for the Kiwis.

FOUR! Bizarre scenes here! The batsman has cut this short ball outside very late and fine to the third man fence for a boundary. But, the bowler seems to be appealing for a hit wicket! That joy though is short-lived as the bails have been disturbed by the wicket-keeper, Latham. Lots of confusion but in the end, the honesty of the keeper is important to ensure no delay in the game. Four runs for Hasan to get off the mark.
Another slider on middle, Mehidy pushes it towards the mid-wicket fielder.
Mehidy Hasan walks in at number 8.

OUT! Clever bowling! Attacks the stumps and bowls a slider on a slightly shorter length. Mithun after playing two balls on the front foot, rocks back to cut this one. The ball though skids through before he can bring the bat down to cut it. The stumps are disturbed and the 75-run partnership has been broken by the leggie. Second wicket for him. Mithun walks back after scoring a good knock of 57 but he will himself know that he had to continue for sometime more.
Hurled in quicker on middle, Mohammad hits it back towards the bowler on a single bounce.
Flatter one on middle and going straight through, Mithun looks to flick it but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Good length delivery on off, Sabbir plays it to point.

FOUR! Nice shot. Second boundary of the over. Full on middle, Rahman drives it through mid on where the diving mid on fielder dives to stop it but it goes through him for a boundary. It was racing to the fence.
Good length delivery on off, Rahman plays it to point.
FOUR! Sabbir Rahman is looking good here. Short of a length delivery, Rahman pulls it over mid-wicket for a boundary. The visitors are dealing in boundaries here.
Full on off, Rahman drives it to mid off.
Good length delivery on off, Rahman defends off the front foot.

Drinks break! After having a break just 2-odd overs back, the players are having an official Drinks break now. Ridiculous wastage of time but that's what it is. Bangladesh are rebuilding well courtesy Sabbir Rahman and Mohammad Mithun here. New Zealand will look to break this partnership.
FOUR! Two boundary balls on a trot. Nice shot. Floated on off, Mithun comes down the track and lofts this over covers for a boundary. Big over for Bangladesh. 12 runs came from it.

SIX! POWERFUL SHOT! Flighted delivery on middle, in his zone, Mithun lofts this over mid-wicket for a maximum. Mohammad reaches his fifty! His fourth in ODI cricket. Needs to continue and go for the three-figure mark now.
Flighted delivery on middle and leg, Sabbir flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Floated on off, Rahman defends off the front foot.
Tossed up on middle, Rahman defends off the back foot.

DROPPED! Tossed up on middle, Mithun looks to play over the bowler but Astle gets a fingertip to it as he reacts a tad late. The ball goes through at a good speed and then very straight where a deep fielder does a fine job to save runs for his team. The batsmen get a single.
Length to end and on off, Sabbir once again blocks it out.
Good length and on off, Sabbir keeps it out.
FOUR! Just over! Second boundary in the over. Short and down the leg side, Sabbir looks to pull but it hits the glove and lobs over the diving Tom Latham. Into the third man fence.
On a good length and around off, kept out.
Another poor delivery! It is short and wide outside off, Sabbir this time mistimes it to covers.
FOUR! Welcome back Boult! Short and wide outside off, Sabbir cuts it through point and the ball races away.
Trent Boult is back on.
Loopy delivery on middle and leg, Mithun flicks it towards mid-wicket. The batsmen get two runs.
Floated on off, Mithun looks to play reverse sweep but misses it and gets hit on the body.
Tossed up on off, Mithun keeps it out.
Short outside off, Rahman cuts it towards point for a single. He could not go for the second because he was struggling with his hamstring.
Flighted delivery on middle, Rahman flicks it to mid-wicket.
Tossed up on leg, Mithun drives it towards mid on for a single.

The physio is out to have a look. Bangladesh will hope it is nothing serious as Mithun is playing really well. The players in the meantime have decided to have a drink. He is now fine to continue though.
Shortish and on the body, it is worked towards square leg for a single. He straightaway holds the back side of his thigh as he completes the run.
FOUR! No protection in the deep and a boundary! Full and on off, Mithun drives it onto the ground, goes over the cover fielders and then to the fence. Into the 40s is Mithun.
A bumper but it is nicely ducked under.
On the off pole, the batter guides it to point.
Good length and on off, Sabbir waits for it and then guides it to third man for a single.
On the fuller side on off, Mithun strokes it towards the bowler. He sticks a hand out but ends up deflecting it towards wide mid off. A run taken.
Flighted delivery on middle, Rahman defends off the back foot.

APPEAL FOR LBW! NOT OUT! Tossed up on middle and leg, Rahman looks to flick but gets hit on the pads. The bowler appeals but the umpire shakes his head. Probably it was missing leg. Williamson wanted to go for the review but Tom Latham told him it would have been missing leg so he decides against the review.
Floated on middle, Mithun flicks it towards mid-wicket. The batsmen take a single.

Full on off, Rahman looks to drive but gets an inside edge. It hits the stumps but the bails does not come off. It goes towards fine leg. The batsmen take a single. Close shave for Sabbir Rahman. This rarely happens in cricket that the ball hits the stumps and the bails don't come off.
Floated delivery on off, Rahman keeps it out.
Tossed up outside off, Sabbir lets it go.
The batsman defends it from within the crease to end the over.
Fuller outside off, driven to the right of cover but not with much timing. Single taken.
Short of a length and hurrying up the batsman, Rahman is keeping it out towards mid-wicket.
A length ball outside off, Mohammad dabs it with soft hands past the off stump and towards the right of slip. A quick single is taken.
A good, solid front foot defense this time from MM.
Pacy ball on a length outside off, 143.3 kph. Mithun takes a big stride ahead to defend and the ball pings off his bat towards point who makes a good diving stop to prevent any runs.
Lockie Ferguson is coming back on. 4-0-22-1 are his figures so far.
Flighted delivery on off, Mithun comes down the track and drives it towards covers. The batsmen cross ends.
Tossed up on middle, Mohammad blocks it off his back foot.
Flighted delivery on off, Mithun defends off the front foot.
FOUR! Good shot. Full toss on off, Mithun plays a reverse paddle towards third man. The fielder chases it and slides to stop it. It runs away quickly to the fence.
Short and outside off, Mithun cuts it to point.
Tossed up on middle, Mithun flicks it towards square leg. The batsmen get two runs.
Another back foot stroke to end the over. Solid defense this time. 3 runs off this one.
Length ball outside off, punched back towards mid on by Sabbir. Not much timing on that one though.
Wide! Hurled way down the leg side and it is wided by the umpire.
On the pads, MM misses his flick. The ball goes off the pads towards the leg side for a leg bye.

Play and a miss! Poor shot from Mithun! A length ball outside off and in the corridor that the bowler wants the batsman to fend at. The ball has some extra bounce after landing on a length. It beats the outside edge of Mohammad who was looking to play a really lazy drive.
Kept out from within the crease by Mithun towards mid-wicket.
Fuller length ball on the off stump, driven slightly wide of mid off to his left by Sabbir and a single is taken.
Short delivery outside off, Mithun cuts it through point. The batsmen pick up a couple. Bangladesh are 115/5 after 25 overs. 8 runs came off the over.
Flighted delivery on middle, Mithun flicks it to mid-wicket.
Short and outside off, Mithun cuts it to point.
Full on middle and leg, Rahman drives it through mid on for a single.
Full on middle, Mithun drives it towards mid on for a run.
FOUR! Good use of the feet. Nice shot. Tossed up outside off, Mithun comes down the track and drives it over covers for a boundary.

FOUR! Poor ball and put away! short and outside off, Sabbir stands tall and cuts it through point. The fielder from that region gives it a chase, dives and looks to pull it back in but fails to do so.
Edged but short! On the off pole and it is on a length. Straightens a touch. Sabbir looks to defend but the ball goes off the outside edge and on the bounce to Taylor at widish second slip.
A good bumper there, Sabbir however evades it well.
Good length again around off, Sabbir defends it nicely.
Full and on off, Sabbir strokes it to mid off.
Good length and on off, kept out.

Run out chance but not taken! They have been very sloppy in the field today. Mithun taps this towards cover and first sets off for a run. Sabbir too goes for it but Mithun bails out. Sabbir is halfway down the track but to his luck, the fielder fails to pick the ball up. He makes it in.
Short and outside off, Mithun cuts it towards point.

FOUR! 100 UP FOR NEW ZEALAND! Good effort goes in vain. Flighted delivery on middle, Mithun comes down the track and lofts it over mid off. The fielder from long off dives, slides to stop it and throws the ball while his body was in contact with the ropes. The third umpire signals it as a boundary.
Flighted delivery on off, Mithun blocks it well.
Short and outside off, Mohammad cuts it to point.
Floated outside off, Mithun plays it to covers.
On the shorter side on off, the batsman pushes it to covers.
In the air... on the bounce! Short and outside off, Mithun throws his bat at it. The ball takes the top edge and goes on the bounce to third man. A single taken.
On the off pole now, this is kept out.
On the shorter side, Sabbir opens the face and plays it down to third man for a single.
Outside off, Mithun plays it with an angled bat down to third man for a run.
On the shorter side, Sabbir does well to get on top of the bounce and guides it down to third man for a single.
A bowling change but no change in the bowling! Neesham too sprays it down the leg side, Sabbir looks to flick but misses. Wided.
James Neesham is on now.
Outside off, Rahman cuts it towards covers for a run.
Sabbir Rahman is in at number 7.

OUT! Bangladesh are losing their way. Astle strikes in his first over, another inspired bowling change from Kane Williamson! A flatter one outside off and turning just a tad bit, Mahmudullah looks to run it down fine of the face of the bat but the ball was too close to the body for him to be playing that shot. He gets a fine tickle and it goes straight into Latham's gloves. Well done on holding on! Half of the side is back in the hut now.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground. They pick up a single.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Short again, Mithun again makes room and cuts it to point.
Short and outside off, Mithun makes room and cuts it to point.
Todd Astle is into the attack.
Delivers this one from wide of the crease and tries to use the angle to bring the ball in, Mohammad opens the face of the bat and guides the ball to the third man for a run.
Short of a length, Mithun tries to pull it away but mistimes the shot towards square leg.
Patted on to the off side and a really quick single is stolen by the batsmen. Good game awareness.

FOUR! Edgy, but Mahmudullah and Bangladesh won't mind. A really full ball outside off and swinging away, the batsman throws his bat at it looking to drive. It takes the outside edge and flies wide of the solo slip in position. Runs to the fence.
On the money once more, just outside off. Defended watchfully onto the off side.
Really full outside off, pushed away on the front foot by Mahmudullah towards point.
Good length delivery on off, Mithun keeps it out.
Full on off, Mahmudullah drives it towards covers for a run.
Full on off, Mahmudullah drives it to covers.
Length delivery on middle, Mithun flicks it towards fine leg for a run.
WIDE! Bowls it down the leg side, Mithun leaves it alone. This is bad bowling from Colin. Eighth wide by him.
Full on leg, Mahmudullah flicks it towards fine leg for a run.
Length delivery outside off, Mithun slaps it through covers for a run.

Drinks break! New Zealand have picked up four wickets in the opening period which saw a 7-minute rain interruption as well. They could have had even more if they had not put down 3 catches. The ball is still doing things and Bangladesh will have to be careful not to just collapse here. Mushfiqur has fallen just when a partnership was budding and now, plenty of rebuilding will have to be done! Meanwhile, Mahmudullah walks out to join Mohammad Mithun in the middle.

OUT! TIMBERRR! Dragged it on. Good length delivery on off, Rahim looks to guide it away from the body but drags it back onto the stumps and gets bowled. The ball came back in sharply due to the inswing on this one. There was no feet movement by Rahim. He does not make most of his reprieve which he got. Lockie Ferguson finally gets his reward for some good bowling and he does not have to depend on the fielding this time. The visitors lose their fourth wicket.
Good length delivery on off, Rahim defends off the back foot.
Length delivery on off, Mithun guides it towards third man for a single.
Short and outside off again, Rahim cuts it through point. The fielder chases it and stops it comfortably. The batsmen get three runs. Good running between the wickets.
Short and outside off, Rahim looks to cut but misses it.
Length delivery outside off, Rahim taps it to point.
FOUR! Just need not run for those! Delightful. Full and on middle, Mithun with a very straight bat drives it past the bowler and it races away to the fence. Runs flowing now.
This is where he should bowl. Right on off and on a length, it is kept out.
A little too straight, Mithun works it to mid-wicket.
Driven nicely but finds the man at cover.
Another wide, 13th in this innings. Down the leg side, Mithun looks to flick but misses.
Nicely played! Waits for the ball to come to him and then guides it late down to third man for a single.
On the off pole, better from Colin. Rahim keeps it out.
Good length delivery on middle, the batsman keeps it out.
Bowls a bouncer, Mithun does well to duck under it.
Good length delivery on off, Mithun blocks it off the back foot.
Short of a length delivery outside off, Rahim cuts it over point. It falls short of the third man fielder. The batsmen take a single.
Length delivery on off, Mithun plays it towards point for a run.

DROPPED! Taylor drops his second of the match. This is poor from Ross. Good length delivery on off, Mithun looks to defend but gets an outside edge due to the movement on this one. It goes to first slip where Ross Taylor seems to have taken it but the ball pops out of his hands. The ball hits hit chin and Rosco tries to hold on in the second attempt but fails to do so. Both the batsmen have got a life here. Ferguson doesn't look pleased.
Fourth consecutive leave for Mushfiqur. Bowls it wide outside off, Rahim lets it go again.
Outside off again, Rahim leaves it alone.
Bowls it wide outside off, the batsman shoulders his arms to this one.
WIDE! Bowls it way outside off, Mushfiqur lets it go.
Good length delivery again on off, Rahim keeps it out.
Good length delivery on off, Rahim looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
FOUR! Cracking shot. Full and outside off, Rahim is quick to pounce on it and drives it through point for a boundary.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat. 10 from this over as well, could have had a wicket too.

FIVE WIDES! Just no chance for the keeper there. It is bowled on leg stump, swings away further. The batsman leaves it, the keeper dives to his left but has no chance of stopping it. It races away to the fine leg fence. Bonus runs.
A delivery more in frustration it seems. Bouncer and on the body, ducked under.

DROPPED AGAIN! Rahim is living a charmed life here. His second reprieve. Easy catch put down by Ross. Length ball outside off, Rahim looks to push at it. The ball takes the outside edge and goes towards Ross at first slip. He seems to have taken it for a second but then the ball pops out. It seems to be Rahim's day today.
That too has come back in a long way, the line though is on the pads. Rahim looks to flick but misses to get hit on the thigh pad.
Gets this one to come back in from outside off, Mithun strokes it towards wide mid off for a quick run.
Nicely played! Ferguson starts off with a half volley on off, Rahim drives it square on the off side. Due to the slow outfield it does not go the fence and three taken.
Lockie Ferguson is into the attack now.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat. End of a long over from Colin de Grandhomme. 9 runs and a wicket came from it.
FOUR! Nice shot. Short and outside off, Mithun slaps it through covers for a boundary.
Bowls it wide outside off, Mithun shoulders his arms to this one.
WIDE! Bowls it down the leg side, Mithun leaves it alone. Colin is losing his radar here.
Outside off, Mithun leaves it alone.
WIDE! Bowls it wide outside off, Mithun easily lets it go.
Mohammad Mithun walks out next.

OUT! EDGED AND TAKEN! Finally Colin gets one right and he strikes. Excellent bowling change by Williamson and just as a partnership was building, it has been cut short. He angles this one across the batter and lands it full on off. Sarkar looks to drive but  ends up playing inside the line. The ball takes the outside edge and goes to the man at widish second slip. Taylor there takes an easy catch. Sarkar walks back after getting a start and Bangladesh slip further.
WIDE! Bowls it down the leg side, Sarkar lets it go. This is horrendous bowling from Colin.
Bowls it outside off, Sarkar leaves it alone.
WIDE! Consecutive wides from Colin de Grandhomme. This is poor bowling from de Grandhomme. Bowls it down the leg side, Sarkar lets it go.
WIDE! Bowls it down the leg side, Sarkar looks to flick but misses it.
Colin de Grandhomme is on now.
Full on middle, Rahim drives it to mid on.
Length delivery again on off, Sarkar plays it towards point. The batsmen change ends.
Length delivery on middle, Rahim flicks it towards square leg for a run.
FOUR! Nice shot. Short of a length delivery, Rahim pulls it over square leg for a boundary. Mushfiqur is making good use of the short ball here.
On middle, Rahim blocks it off the back foot.
Good length delivery on off, Rahim blocks it well.

Left on length again! On middle but it is slightly short. Sarkar takes his pads out of the way and leaves it. Goes over the stumps again. Another good over for Bangladesh. 7 from it and 16 have come from the last two.
FOUR! This is right off the middle and Sarkar gets the desired result. Full and outside off, Sarkar just opens the face of the bat and hits it through point. No stopping those.
Over! On the fuller side outside off, Sarkar looks to drive, it is not right off the middle but hits it well enough to get it over cover for a couple.

DROPPED! Through the hands! That went to the fielder like a rocket but should have been taken. The short ball ploy to Rahim almost worked. He does hit it well but uppishly to the man at square leg who is quite close in. Astle there gets two hands to it but can't hold on. The batsmen take a run. A life for Rahim, Bangladesh would love it if he makes it count.
A little full again, Rahim works it with the angle to mid on.
On the shorter side on middle, Rahim nudges it towards square leg.
Powerplay 2 has been signaled! Now a maximum of 4 fielders can be placed outside the ring till the 40th over.

FOUR LEG BYES! Length delivery on leg, Sarkar looks to flick but gets it off his pads. It goes towards fine leg for a boundary. 9 runs came off the over and it is the most expensive over till now. Powerplay 1 is over. 32 runs and 2 wickets came from it.
On off, Sarkar defends off the front foot.
Good length delivery outside off, Sarkar looks to defend but gets beaten by the away movement on this one.

FOUR! EDGY FOUR! Good length delivery on off, Sarkar looks to defend but gets beaten by the away swing. He gets an outside edge and it goes between first slip and widish third slip towards third man for a boundary.
Short of a length delivery, Rahim pulls it through backward square leg. Matt Henry makes a brilliant stop at deep backward square leg. The batsmen take a run.
Bowls a bouncer, Rahim does well to duck under it. Boult is testing the batsmen with short balls.
Nope! An edgy run! Full and tailing away from off pole, Rahim looks to force it through covers but the ball goes off the outside edge down to third man for a single.
On the fuller side, Rahim strokes it back towards the bowler who stops it well in his followthrough. 5 dots, can he bowl another maiden?
Well bowled and well played! Length delivery and on off, Rahim plants his front foot forward and defends it to cover-point.
On the stumps, Rahim works it to mid on.
Slightly fuller but the line is outside off, not way outside off but wide enough to not bother the batsman.
Left that on length! A good one in the end! Slightly shorter and on off, it comes back in. Rahim shoulders arms and it goes over the stumps.

Full on off, Rahim drives it through mid off. Williamson chases it and stops it comfortably. The batsmen get three runs. Good running between the wickets. The outfield has become slow because of the passing shower so it was an easy stop for the skipper.
Length delivery on middle and leg, Rahim looks to flick but gets hit on the thigh pad.
Full on off, Sarkar drives it towards covers. The batsmen cross ends.
Bowls a bouncer, Sarkar ducks underneath it.
Length delivery outside off, Sarkar drives it uppishly over covers. The batsmen get two runs.
Full outside off, Sarkar drives it to covers. Soumya is trying to play way too away from the body. Not a good idea when the ball is swinging.
Good delivery to a new batsman! On middle and it is on a length. Blocked. End of a wicket-maiden for Henry.
Mushfiqur Rahim is in at number 4.

OUT! Umpire's call and Tamim has to walk back. He though does not take a review with him. Both the Kiwi new ball bowlers have struck now. However, Henry has got the big fish. The length was the key here, he has been getting it full from the last few deliveries and he gets the reward. This pitches on middle and it is just ahead of a good length. Comes back in. Tamim plants his front foot across and looks to flick, misses to get hit on the front pad. An appeal and the umpire agrees. Tamim reviews after a chat with his partner. Replays show that the on-field call is the right one. Both the openers back without making an impact and Bangladesh in trouble here.
Review time... Tamim has been ruled out LBW here. He looks plumb in front but he wants to try his luck with the DRS. Height is the only thing that can save him here...
Close! Once again the in-dipper around off, Iqbal plays outside the line, it goes off the inner half towards mid-wicket.
On the shorter side, Tamim stands tall and punches it to mid off.

A huge shout but that is slipping down leg. Better length though from Henry. It is fuller and it pitches around leg. Tamim looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. An appeal follows but the umpire shakes his head. It might have been slipping down leg. Hawk Eye shows it to be pitching outside leg.
Hits the length hard around off, Tamim goes back and keeps it out.
Good length delivery again outside off, Soumya offers no shot.
Good length delivery on off, Sarkar defends off the back foot.
Full on off, Sarkar drives it to covers.

FOUR! Cracking shot. First boundary of the match. Short of a length delivery, Sarkar pulls it through backward square leg. Matt Henry from fine leg runs and slides to stop it but it was always running away to the fence.
Length delivery on off, Sarkar plays it to point.
Bowls wide outside off, Sarkar shoulders his arms to this one.
APPEAL FOR LBW! NOT OUT! Good length delivery on middle, Iqbal looks to flick but gets hit high on the pads. The bowler appeals but the umpire shakes his head. Probably height would have saved him.
Good length delivery on off, Iqbal defends it off the back foot.
Length delivery on off, Sarkar plays it towards third man for a single.
Length delivery on middle and leg, the left-hander flicks it towards fine leg for a single.
Good length delivery on off, Tamim looks to defend but it goes of the outer half of the bat. It goes to the leg side.
Oh yes, there we go! The players are back. The drizzle is around though but it is insignificant and we are all set to resume. Matt Henry going to his run up, Tamim Iqbal will continue facing him...
Update 1125 local - The covers (read cover) are being removed now. A clothed rope is being run across to remove the wetness from the outfield. Hopefully, we should be resuming real quick!

The rain has increased and the players are going off. The groundsmen are rushing onto the field with the covers. It looks like a passing shower though. And just as the players make their way out of the ground, the rain seems to have disappeared. The umpires take a U-turn and come back towards the pitch which is currently covered.
Good length delivery on off, Iqbal drives it to covers.
It has started to drizzle a bit. We are carrying on though as of now.
Another one on the pads, it is once again flicked through square leg for another single. End of a successful over for Boult.
On the pads again, it is flicked down to fine leg for a run.

Top delivery! Goes for a yorker but ends up bowling a low full toss, Sarkar flicks it through square leg. He falls over as he attempts to do so. Gets up, takes one and then goes for the second. Complete it.
Edged but a run! Another length ball and once again it shapes away. Iqbal looks to defend but the ball goes off the outside edge towards third man for a single.

Leading edge! On a length and around off, it shapes away a little. Iqbal plays it with a closed face of the bat. The ball takes the leading edge and goes towards point. Not good from Tamim, he got out playing with a closed face in the first game, he should not be repeating the same.
Soumya Sarkar is the new man in.

OUT! In the air... and what a catch! Lockie Ferguson has taken a brilliant catch. Liton Das departs on the very first ball he faces from Boult. Das uses his feet to cover the swing. Boult however drops it a little shorter than the length he was bowling in his first over. Das plays a nothing shot, he ends up chipping it over mid off. For a second he might have thought he would get away but Lockie Ferguson backtracks, keeps his eyes on the ball and takes it nicely. Never easy those. Another failure for Das and the Kiwis strike early.
Length delivery on leg, Tamim flicks it through square leg. The batsmen pick up a couple.

RUN OUT CHANCE! MISSED! Length delivery on off, Iqbal plays it towards covers. He goes for an unnecessary single and is halfway down the track. However, Das sends him back. Williamson has a shy at the stumps and throws it at the striker's end but the throw is wayward. Tom Latham fails to collect it. Williamson is a good fielder and rarely he makes such errors.
WIDE! Bowls it down the leg side, Iqbal looks to flick but misses it. The umpire signals it as wide. The replays show that it had hit his pocket. Harsh call from the umpire.
Good length delivery on off, Iqbal defends off the back foot.
Good short ball from Tamim Iqbal. Bowls a bumper, Iqbal does well to duck under it.
Good length delivery on middle, Iqbal nudges it to the leg side.
Length delivery on off, Das taps it towards third man for a single.

Squares him up! An excellent nut to end the over. Length and it shapes away late. It is on off hence Tamim has to play but the away movement beats the outside edge of Tamim's bat. A maiden to begin with and a good one by Boult.
Extra bounce there! Bends his back on this one, lands it on off, it takes off. Tamim tries to defend but taking a hand off the handle, the ball hits the higher portion of the bat.
A solid looking defensive stroke that. On the off pole, Tamim defends it with a straight bat.
A bumper and a well-directed one. Tamim ducks under it. A surprise short delivery that, don't think Tamim was expecting him to go short so early. He though evades it well.
Slants it away once again but the line is a little too wide outside off, left alone.
Yes, he does, just a little shape outwards. He goes fuller, Tamim however, plants his front foot ahead and strokes it to covers.
Trent Boult to bowl with the second new ball. Will he get some swing?
On off, Das blocks it off the back foot. Good start for New Zealand. Just one run off the over.
Length delivery on leg, Das nudges it to the leg side.

Good length delivery on middle and leg, the left-hander looks to defend but gets hit on the thigh pad. It goes towards the leg side. The batsmen take a run. Umpire gives it as a leg bye. First run for Bangladesh.
Good length delivery on off, Tamim keeps it out.
Good length delivery on off, Iqbal looks to defend but gets hit on the stomach.
Not a lot of swing on this one. Starts with a good length delivery on off, Iqbal defends off the front foot.
We are all set to begin. The players and umpires are out in the middle. Tamim Iqbal and Liton Das will open the innings for Bangladesh. Matt Henry will start the proceedings for New Zealand.
TOSS - New Zealand won the toss and elect to field.

Hello and a warm welcome to the 2nd ODI between New Zealand and Bangladesh at Christchurch. The first match was a one-sided match where the Kiwis came out on top. It is a must-win game for the visitors and one would expect a better show from them. The hosts on the other hand would like to wrap up the series here itself. Will it be 2-0 in favour of the hosts or will Bangladesh bounce back? Stay tuned for the toss.
